project.name: Growing Humans
project.intro: Built an Angular and NestJS application combining an age-aware AI guide, knowledge exploration and NASA-based STEAM activities.
bullets: Integrated OpenRouter behind a server-side provider boundary, with structured model responses, validation and timeouts.
Implemented input and output safety checks for the guide, with confidence gates and reviewed fallback responses when AI is unavailable or unsuitable.
Designed the STEAM workflow to send fixed selection IDs instead of child-authored text; validated generated activities and gated release through a separate safety decision.
Kept provider credentials server-side and implemented API validation, throttling and configurable AI feature controls.
